name: Richmond County, NY
findings: Richmond County has 1,385 nonprofit organizations. 496 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 400 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Richmond County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 8 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 24 would.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 25 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Richmond County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 285 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 161 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 161 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
